About the clinic

One clinic for your smile, your skin and your hair

East Hills Dental and Aesthetics Clinic brings complete dental care together with advanced aesthetic treatments in a single, calm setting in Islamabad's E-11 sector. Instead of travelling between separate practices, you can look after your teeth, refresh your skin and restore your hair in one place.

Every treatment begins with a consultation, so your options are explained clearly and the plan is shaped around what you actually need — nothing more, nothing less.

  • Complete dental care Check-ups, cleanings, fillings and restorative dentistry for the whole family.
  • Advanced aesthetics Laser treatments, PRP, dermal fillers and Hydrafacial for natural-looking results.
  • Hair restoration Hair transplant and PRP options, assessed honestly at your consultation.

Treatments

What we can help you with

Six core services across dentistry, skin and hair. Rates are confirmed at consultation — call or message us and we will talk you through your options.

Laser Treatments

Laser-based treatments for skin and hair concerns, using modern aesthetic laser technology. Your consultation will confirm which treatment suits your skin type and goals.

Call for consultation rates Ask on WhatsApp

PRP Therapy

Platelet-rich plasma prepared from your own blood, used to support skin rejuvenation and hair restoration. A natural option discussed in detail at your consultation.

Call for consultation rates Ask on WhatsApp

Dermal Fillers

Injectable fillers that restore lost volume and smooth facial contours for a refreshed, natural-looking result — planned around your features, never overdone.

Call for consultation rates Ask on WhatsApp

Hydrafacial

A multi-step facial that cleanses, exfoliates and deeply hydrates the skin, leaving it fresh and glowing — gentle enough for regular care and special occasions alike.

Call for consultation rates Ask on WhatsApp

Hair Transplant

Surgical hair restoration that relocates healthy follicles to thinning areas for natural-looking coverage. Suitability and expected results are assessed honestly at consultation.

Call for consultation rates Ask on WhatsApp

General Dentistry

Complete everyday dental care — examinations, professional cleaning, fillings and restorative work — to keep your teeth and gums healthy at every age.
